attributsDescriptions.Close Shot: Ability to shoot when standing still out to 10 feet from the basket. Helps post hooks, and is also used to determine the ability to make standing alley-oop and putback layup attempts.
attributsDescriptions.Driving Layup: Determines the ability to successfully complete regular, contact, alley-oop and putback layup attempts while moving toward the basket.
attributsDescriptions.Driving Dunk: Determines the ability to successfully complete regular, contact, alley-oop and putback dunk attempts while moving toward the basket.
attributsDescriptions.Standing Dunk: Determines the ability to successfully complete regular, contact, alley-oop and putback dunk attempts while standing under the basket.
attributsDescriptions.Post Control: Helps determine success when performing spins, drives, drop steps and other moves from post position.
attributsDescriptions.Mid-Range: Determines the ability to make shots of all types from mid-range distance, including post fadeaway attempts.
attributsDescriptions.Three-Point: Determines the ability to make shots of all types from three-point distance.
attributsDescriptions.Free Throw: Determines the ability of successfully making free throw shot attempts.
attributsDescriptions.Pass Accuracy: Ability to throw the ball on target in all types of passing situations, such as bounce, chest, lob, overhead, flashy and alley-oop passes.
attributsDescriptions.Ball Handle: Determines skill while dribbling the ball, both in terms of moves allowed and securing the ball from steal attempts.
attributsDescriptions.Speed With Ball: Affects how fast the player can run or sprint while dribbling the ball.
attributsDescriptions.Interior Defense: Determines the ability for the player to defend the paint both on and off the ball, as well as contest shots near the rim.
attributsDescriptions.Perimeter Defense: Determines the ability for the player to defend the perimeter both on and off the ball, as well as contest shots from outside.
attributsDescriptions.Steal: Ability to intercept or deflect passes and steal the ball from opposing ball-handlers in all situations.
attributsDescriptions.Block: Determines the chance to successfully block shots of all types.
attributsDescriptions.Offensive Rebound: Ability to grab offensive rebounds. Along with vertical, unlocks rebound content to reach the ball more easily on missed shots.
attributsDescriptions.Defensive Rebound: Ability to grab defensive rebounds. Along with vertical, unlocks rebound content to reach the ball more easily on missed shots.
attributsDescriptions.Speed: Affects how fast the player can run or sprint around the court.
attributsDescriptions.Agility: Without the ball, affects how fast the player can accelerate, move in short bursts and move laterally.
attributsDescriptions.Strength: Determines who wins a contact battle and helps dictate how successful a player will be when backing down or being backed down in the post.
attributsDescriptions.Vertical: Used as a gate for dunk animations, and in combination with attribute counterparts, allows a player to jump higher on rebounds and blocks.

badgesDescriptions.Aerial Wizard: Increases ability to finish an alley-oop dunk from a teammate, or an in-air putback dunk off an offensive rebound.
badgesDescriptions.Float Game: Increases a player's ability to finish floaters.
badgesDescriptions.Ghost Stepper: Increases the effectiveness of step-through layups or other close-range shots that come after a shot fake.
badgesDescriptions.Hook Specialist: Improves ability to make post hooks.
badgesDescriptions.Layup Mixmaster: Improves a player's ability to finish fancy or acrobatic layups.
badgesDescriptions.Paint Prodigy: Improves a player's ability to quickly and effectively score while going to work in the paint.
badgesDescriptions.Physical Finisher: Improves a player's ability to battle through contact and convert contact layups.
badgesDescriptions.Post Powerhouse: Strengthens a player's ability at backing down defenders and moving them with drop steps.
badgesDescriptions.Post Spin Catalyst: Attempting post spins or drives results in more effective moves and less of a chance to be stripped.
badgesDescriptions.Posterizer: Increases the chances of throwing down a dunk on your defender while driving to the hoop.
badgesDescriptions.Rise Up: Increases the likelihood of dunking on your opponent when standing in the painted area.
badgesDescriptions.Arc Cadence: Improves a player's ability to knock down 3-point shots on the move, including pull-ups, hop-steps, or spin shots.
badgesDescriptions.Deadeye: Jump shots taken with a defender closing out receive less of a penalty from a shot contest.
badgesDescriptions.Limitless Range: Extends the range from which a player can shoot 3PT shots effectively from deep.
badgesDescriptions.Mini Marksman: Shorter shooters are less bothered by lengthy defenders.
badgesDescriptions.Post Fade Phenom: Improves ability to make post fades and hop shots.
badgesDescriptions.Quick Trigger: Improves a player's ability to make no-dip jump shots.
badgesDescriptions.Set and Fire: Applies a shooting boost to 3-point shots when the player's feet are completely set.
badgesDescriptions.Smooth Operator: Improves a player's ability to knock down mid-range shots on the move, including pull-ups, hop-steps, or spin shots.
badgesDescriptions.Static Middy: Applies a shooting boost to stand-still mid-range shots.
badgesDescriptions.Ankle Assassin: Increases the ability to break down the defender and cross them up.
badgesDescriptions.Bail Out: Passing out of a jump shot or layup yields fewer errant passes than normal. Additionally helps passing out of double teams.
badgesDescriptions.Break Starter: After grabbing a defensive rebound, deep outlet passes made up the court are more accurate. Passes must be made quickly following the defensive rebound.
badgesDescriptions.Dimer: Boosts the shot percentage for open teammates after catching a pass.
badgesDescriptions.Handles for Days: Allows a player to take less of an energy hit when performing consecutive dribble moves.
badgesDescriptions.Lightning Launch: Speeds up launches when attacking from the perimeter.
badgesDescriptions.Pace: Raises the speed of the ball handler when sprinting.
badgesDescriptions.Strong Handle: Reduces the likelihood of being bothered by defenders when dribbling.
badgesDescriptions.Unpluckable: Defenders have a tougher time poking the ball free with their steal attempts.
badgesDescriptions.Versatile Visionary: Improves a player's ability to thread and fire tight passes, including alley-oops, quickly and on time.
badgesDescriptions.Ankle Braces: Lowers the likelihood of getting ankle-broken by opposing dribble moves.
badgesDescriptions.Challenger: Improves the effectiveness of well-timed contests against perimeter shooters.
badgesDescriptions.Glove: Increases the ability to successfully steal from ball handlers or strip layup attempts.
badgesDescriptions.High-Flying Denier: Boosts the speed and leaping ability of a defensive player in anticipation of a chase-down block attempt.
badgesDescriptions.Immovable Enforcer: Improves a defensive player's strength when defending ball handlers and finishers coming straight at them.
badgesDescriptions.Interceptor: The frequency of successfully tipped or intercepted passes greatly increases.
badgesDescriptions.Off-Ball Pest: Makes players more difficult to get past when playing off-ball, as they can grab and hold their matchup.
badgesDescriptions.Paint Patroller: Increases a player's ability to block or contest shots at the rim.
badgesDescriptions.Pick Dodger: Improves a player's ability to navigate through and around screens while on defense.
badgesDescriptions.Post Lockdown: Strengthens a player's ability to effectively defend moves in the post, with an increased chance of stripping the opponent.
badgesDescriptions.Seatbelt: Boosts body-up defense effectiveness, making it easier to clamp opponents and disrupt their drive path.
badgesDescriptions.Wall Up: Improves shot contest effectiveness during hands-up defense when guarding the paint.
badgesDescriptions.Boxout Boss: Improves the effectiveness of boxouts as the boxer.
badgesDescriptions.Breaker: Increases the success rate of breaking through opponent boxouts.
badgesDescriptions.Crasher: Boosts a player's ability to track down or grab rebounds on the offensive end.
badgesDescriptions.Possession Closer: Boosts a player's ability to grab rebounds on the defensive end.
badgesDescriptions.Sync Snatcher: Gives an additional Vertical and Rebounding boost when perfectly timing the jump.
badgesDescriptions.Brick Wall: Increases the effectiveness of screens and drains energy from opponents who fight through them.
badgesDescriptions.Bruiser: Drains energy from opponents when making physical contact.
badgesDescriptions.Flash: Speeds up movement without the ball while in transition on offense or defense.
badgesDescriptions.Pogo Stick: Improves a player's ability to attempt a second jump quickly, whether for a rebound, a block or a shot.
badgesDescriptions.Slippery Off-Ball: When attempting to get open, the player navigates through traffic more easily and opponents have a harder time staying in front.
badgesDescriptions.Work Horse: Increases a player's speed and ability to get loose balls over the opponent.
